    Source: ClinicalTrials.gov, operated by the U.S. National Library of Medicine at NIH. PBM.science filters three search expressions, removes duplicate NCT identifiers, maps source status labels for filtering and displays selected structured fields; contact details and full descriptions are omitted. The API data timestamp and this snapshot's retrieval date are shown separately. Registry statuses can lag behind actual recruitment, so verify each entry at its source. PBM.science is independent and is not endorsed by ClinicalTrials.gov, NLM or NIH. This password-protected page is excluded from search indexing.
